verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that AiPrise serves a live, structured llms.txt at docs.aiprise.com (HTTP 200, with a titled index of documentation sections). A second probe shows the docs are also available as markdown (.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable documentation. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the agent-oriented docs, evidence that the llms.txt/markdown coverage is complete (e.g., an llms-full.txt), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.aiprise.com/llms.txt # AiPrise Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.aiprise.com/.md # AiPrise Documentation
